prototype.name: STAT1_DIRECT_STAGE75_TIER_A
prototype.role: Synthetic biological prototype only; not project target and not a causal GRN.
prototype.evidence: Stage75 Tier-A direct-motif candidate edges plus Stage76 coactivity sign. Descriptive soft prior only; no validated regulation/causality claim.

source_observation_model.principle: Generate donor/cell biology first, then assign source. Source/operator may alter visibility/noise but cannot cause latent donor activity or R.
source_observation_model.visibility_source: MG_STAT1_DIRECT_DETECTION_BY_SOURCE.csv from authenticated 665-cell pathology-blind TRAIN microglia subset

worlds.rna_only: FOUNDATION-like RNA observation of donor-structured R.
worlds.same_nucleus: RNA and ATAC share the same cell-level R. Geometry analogue of GSE214979; this is planted truth, not a claim of observed STAT1 validation in GSE214979.
worlds.separate_nucleus: RNA and ATAC are independent nuclei sampled from the same donor-level prevalence. Geometry analogue of Morabito; never false-pair cells.
worlds.technical_twin: Biological R is exactly zero while an observation-side pseudo-rare disturbance is frequency-matched to the selected empirical rarity regime.

required_gates: latent biology independent of source assignment
donor-sparse rarity with many exact-zero donors
same-nucleus RNA/ATAC coupling distinguishable from technical twin
separate-nucleus world has donor-level concordance without cell pairing
source-specific visibility changes observed RNA but not latent R
Q00-Q11 remain byte-immutable and are never regenerated

external_evidence_boundary.GSE214979: Same-nucleus pairing is authenticated, but the currently available cached evidence does not establish STAT1-specific same-cell RNA/ATAC coherence. Future post-freeze evaluation is required.
external_evidence_boundary.Morabito_GSE174367: Separate-nucleus donor-level evidence only; cannot establish same-cell correspondence.
external_evidence_boundary.Stage75_76: Supports realistic topology/sign hypotheses and matched controls, not causal truth.
